name: Universal ProjectOps Artifact Layout
principle: All user-facing generated outputs are descendants of the project artifact root. Runtime state and update inboxes are not artifacts.

nonArtifactState..subspace: live internal project/control state and last-green pointer

failureHandoff.windowsBehavior: open Explorer with current debug ZIP selected
failureHandoff.purpose: drag current failure evidence directly into ChatGPT/Cortex support workflow

cortexTarget: Cortex ProjectOps should treat artifactRoot as a capability supplied by project.control.json and surface debug/source/gate/package outputs from this hierarchy.
